question: Q1d: compliant contact forces under dynamic impacts

metadata.restitution_definition: ratio of interpolated velocities at symmetric crossings of the touch plane z=0; equals far-field ratio by gravity symmetry

convergence.note: stiff dt rule: literal 1e-7 s for k=8e4,m=1,b<=400; otherwise coarsest dt with omega*dt<=3e-3; halving dt moves F_max less than the reported spreads

anomaly_notes: phantom preload at geometric touch: pen=ln2/beta_soft=6.931e-05 m gives k*pen = 1.73 N (k=2.5e4) before any real overlap; this is also why the minimum sampled contact force equals k*ln2/beta_soft rather than 0

static-equilibrium surprise (opposite sign vs naive theory): the damping branch never sleeps -- softplus_pen(0,1e3)=ln2/1e3 adds b*act*6.931e-04 N of EXTRA SUPPORT at rest, so measured rest penetration is SHALLOWER than mg/k by b*ln2/(1e3*k), and the naive theory mg/k + ln2/beta_soft overestimates by ~ln2/beta_soft = 6.931e-05 m (see 'diff' column)
approach-speed clamp saturates for v0=2.0 impacts (23377 sampled states capped at 2.0 m/s): caps the damping contribution to F_max for fast impacts

stiff-limit reference carries an instantaneous Kelvin-Voigt touch spike F=b*v0 (no activation gate): whenever b*v0 exceeds the spring-dominated peak, Fmax_stiff == b*v0 exactly (24/81 scenarios spike-limited). Excluding those, stiff-vs-ODE agreement is <= 2.10% for k=8e4; worst overall rel diff 49.04% at (v0=0.5, m=1.0, k=15000.0, b=800.0)
softest contacts (k=1.5e4): rel diffs -49.04%..1.25% -- graceful degradation; ramp eps=1e-4 m is still << peak penetrations (>= 0.7 mm)

11 heavily-damped light-mass scenarios never rebound (contact damping ratio >~ 1): they creep asymptotically to the damped equilibrium inside the contact zone and are reported with e = 0; restitution stays strictly < 1 everywhere (max e over grid: 0.9520)
